# bumble:futurespace

> Coding & robotics courses for kids 8–14 using the mbot2 platform. Hands-on programming, real hardware, small groups. Powered by bumble:education.

## Available Courses

| Course | Ages | Level | Language | Duration | Price | Booking |
|--------|------|-------|----------|----------|-------|---------|
| Robot Explorer | 8–10 | Beginner | Block coding | 8 weeks, 60–75 min | €25 | [Book](https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/robot-explorer/) |
| Code the Machine | 11–14 | Intermediate | Python | 10 weeks, 90 min | €40 | [Book](https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/code-the-machine/) |

Both courses run weekly during the school term. All materials included — kids keep their mbot2 robot. No prior experience needed for either course.

- **Robot Explorer** is the entry point: kids build a robot from parts and learn coding through colorful drag-and-drop blocks.
- **Code the Machine** is the next step: kids transition to real Python, work with sensors (ultrasonic, infrared, light), and build an autonomous maze-navigating robot.

## Quick Facts

- **Age group:** 8–14 years
- **Platform:** mbot2 (Makeblock)
- **Languages:** German, English
- **Location:** Munich, Germany
- **Price:** €25 (Robot Explorer) / €40 (Code the Machine)
- **Run by:** bumble:education (part of bumbleflies)
- **Booking:** https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/
- **What's included:** All materials, instruction, and the mbot2 robot to keep
